boot_layout: one arm per boot; all 12 boots (6 SQLite, 6 PostgreSQL) in parallel on one host, each with its own QEMU lock and work directory
workload: work.sql (f4310b75) plus one appended pg_backend_memory_contexts query, postgres --single
appended_query: SELECT name, ident, parent, level, total_bytes, total_nblocks, free_bytes, free_chunks, used_bytes FROM pg_backend_memory_contexts ORDER BY level, name, ident NULLS FIRST, parent NULLS FIRST, total_bytes, total_nblocks, free_bytes, free_chunks, used_bytes;
guest_command: su nobody -s /bin/sh -c "cd /mnt/vm/<arm>; /usr/bin/time -v /mnt/vm/capstone-vexec ./bin/postgres --single -D /tmp/pgcluster-<arm> -c shared_buffers=4MB -c max_connections=10 -c timezone=GMT -c log_timezone=GMT -c dynamic_shared_memory_type=sysv -c exit_on_error=true postgres < /mnt/vm/work-mem.sql", env CAPSTONE_EXEC_DIAGNOSTICS=1 CAPSTONE_VM_STATS=1
native_rows_sha256: 280000084d6bc8493f3c91444aed0fc7d3d09d0c38e05030deb4ec809d25789c (run-ports pg_rows joined with \n plus a trailing \n, as in the same-answers result.json)

counter_sources.memory_contexts: the appended query, single-user tuple output parsed per attribute; a NULL ident/parent is not printed and is recorded as null
counter_sources.launcher_stats: capstone-vexec --stats immediately before and after the run; delta = after - before
counter_sources.process_vm_stats: CAPSTONE_VM_STATS line printed by the launcher at the domain exit (pages and peak are pinned 4 KiB pages)
counter_sources.time_v_max_rss_kib: busybox time -v "Maximum resident set size" (wait4 ru_maxrss) of the launcher process and its reaped children
counter_sources.vmhwm_last_sample_kib: background /proc/<pid>/status VmHWM sampler; INVALID: recorded a pid other than the launcher main process, see README
